stories.title: Vanessa Trump says she is cancer-free six months after diagnosis
stories.summary: Vanessa Trump, the ex-wife of Donald Trump Jr. with whom she shares five children, says she is cancer-free six months after revealing a breast cancer diagnosis in May.

stories.title: Two rescued after Nairobi building collapse, five still missing
stories.summary: Rescue teams pulled two people alive from a multi-storey building that collapsed while still under construction in Kenya's capital. Police have launched a manhunt for the building's owner and contractor with five people unaccounted for.

stories.title: Israeli forces demolish Hebron homes, displacing Palestinian families
stories.summary: Israeli forces demolished homes in Hebron, displacing Palestinian families, according to local officials. The demolitions came a day after two Israeli soldiers were killed by Palestinian gunmen and days ahead of Israel's election.

stories.title: British woman dies trying to rescue sons swept out to sea in the Bahamas
stories.summary: A British woman died after attempting to rescue her sons after they were swept away at sea in the Bahamas. Her partner said the loss of childhood sweetheart Leanne is "unimaginable" for the family.

stories.title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn't make it
stories.summary: TechCrunch is tracking AI projects and startups that shut down or badly missed expectations, from Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy "super app" launch. The list is a running reality check on the sector's hype cycle.

stories.title: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
stories.summary: Gov. Josh Shapiro signed Pennsylvania's Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act, requiring disclosures on AI-generated ads whether image, video, audio or text. It is one of the first state laws aimed squarely at synthetic political advertising before the midterms.

stories.title: Instacart reportedly discussed selling itself to DoorDash and Uber
stories.summary: Instacart has held talks about a possible sale to larger competitors DoorDash or Uber, according to reports. No deal has been announced and terms were not disclosed.

stories.title: Block's new voice model sounds eerily human and runs on a laptop
stories.summary: Block introduced a voice model it says can run locally on a MacBook M4 Max while producing unusually natural speech. Local inference could cut cost and latency for AI voice products.

stories.title: Browns activate RB Dylan Sampson, place G Teven Jenkins on IR
stories.summary: Cleveland activated Dylan Sampson off injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game at Tennessee after a knee injury cost him most of the season, and put guard Teven Jenkins on IR with a back injury. Safety Grant Delpit also cleared concussion protocol with no injury designation.

stories.title: 3 burning questions for Browns vs. Titans in Week 7
stories.summary: Cleveland takes a 4-2 record and first place in the AFC North to Tennessee on Sunday. The preview focuses on Deshaun Watson's uneven play and an offense still ranked near the bottom of the league in yards and points.

stories.title: Mason Graham cleared to return for Browns at Tennessee
stories.summary: Defensive tackle Mason Graham will play Sunday after missing two games with knee and ankle injuries. Graham still leads Cleveland with four sacks despite the absence, a boost for a defensive line already playing well.

stories.title: Julian Sayin breaks silence after injury: 'Behind my guys, every step of the way'
stories.summary: Ohio State quarterback Julian Sayin posted publicly for the first time since his arm injury, thanking teammates and saying he is behind them every step of the way. Sayin is out indefinitely, leaving the Buckeyes' quarterback plan unsettled during the bye week.

stories.title: Ohio State offer 'hard to believe' for 2029 TE Max Hopkins after first visit
stories.summary: Prospect Max Hopkins said his Ohio State offer was hard to believe and called his first visit to Columbus an awesome experience. The 2029 tight end is the latest early target to leave campus with an offer.

stories.title: Hamilton fastest in final practice for the US Grand Prix
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton topped FP3 at Circuit of the Americas ahead of Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc, completing a Ferrari sweep of the weekend's practice sessions. Qualifying for the United States Grand Prix follows later today in Austin.

stories.title: F1 Icons: Freddie Hunt on his father's 'incredible' 1976 title
stories.summary: Freddie Hunt looks back at James Hunt's 1976 world championship in Formula 1's Icons series. The piece revisits a title fight that remains one of the sport's most famous, 50 years on.

stories.title: Textile artists bring patchwork display to Decorative Arts Center of Ohio
stories.summary: An exhibition of patchwork quilts made by individual textile artists is on display at the Decorative Arts Center of Ohio. Each of the square quilts measures 80 inches a side and is uniquely designed.

stories.title: Ohio policymakers wrestle with prediction markets as wagers surge
stories.summary: Ohio officials are weighing how to handle prediction markets as betting on sports and politics explodes; on Polymarket, users had staked $1.4 million on the state's U.S. Senate race as of Oct. 21. Another $603,000 was riding on the governor's race.

stories.title: Driver who fled trooper at 130 mph and hit Columbus home is sentenced
stories.summary: A driver who crashed into a Columbus home in February after fleeing an Ohio state trooper at 130 mph was sentenced to two years of community control, court records show.

stories.title: One seriously injured in Hamilton Township house fire
stories.summary: One person was seriously injured in a house fire Saturday morning in Hamilton Township, south of Columbus. Crews responded to the blaze; further details were not immediately available.
